answer.value: Pretraining data is a mix of publicly available data, licensed data, and information from Meta's products and services (including publicly shared Instagram and Facebook posts and people's interactions with Meta AI). Safety fine-tuning data combines human-generated data from vendors with synthetic data.
quotes: Overview: Llama 4 Scout was pretrained on ~40 trillion tokens and Llama 4 Maverick was pretrained on ~22 trillion tokens of multimodal data from a mix of publicly available, licensed data and information from Meta’s products and services. This includes publicly shared posts from Instagram and Facebook and people’s interactions with Meta AI.
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.
